Material Symbols Outlined — Google

This test-only font contains chevron_left, chevron_right, first_page and last_page.
The subset was produced by Google Fonts using:
https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Material+Symbols+Outlined&icon_names=chevron_left,chevron_right,first_page,last_page

It is served locally so pagination layout tests exercise real icon ligatures
without depending on external font requests. Applications load the standard
Material Symbols Outlined font as documented by Weave's Icons examples.
